CustomField.description: When checked, every email sent through EmailService (Custom Email Alerts and Apex EmailRequests) is a dry run: sent only to the dry-run addresses (DryRunAddresses__c), "DRY RUN - " before the subject, the real recipients listed at the top of the body. Meant for sandboxes (org default checked), with an unchecked value on a user or profile who needs the real emails.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check (org default, in a sandbox) so that no email of the email engine reaches its real recipients: they all go to the Dry Run Addresses as dry runs. Uncheck on a user or profile to let their emails go out for real.
CustomField.label: Force Dry Run
